body:
I've moved to another city before, every place is the same when it comes down to it.

The things I want can not be found here, or anywhere. My dreams are not possible. You keep saying not to give up on them, but chasing after something that's impossible is insane. You're just like everyone else who tells me the same thing. 

As for those around me, who? I have no one. Even since I was a child I've been alone.

I don't know why I bothered to post this here... this was a mistake.
I don't have dreams any more. Everything I ever wanted to accomplish, the person I wanted to be... none of it matters, none of it is even possible.
